cues: Break the loop and you see the diseases.
With no iodine, thyroxine cannot be made, so T S H is never switched off and keeps whipping the thyroid, which swells: simple goitre.
Too little thyroxine in a baby causes cretinism; in an adult, myxoedema.
Too much causes Graves' disease, with bulging eyes.
